title: Liability Loss Experience Load on CondoGuard Liability Steps
content:
Underwriting bulletin on the liability step premium of the CondoGuard Unit-Owners Policy when the personal liability limit is raised.

**Rule.** The liability loss multiplier on the liability step premium counts the medical payments and personal liability claim payments issued on the policy fewer than 60 whole months before the day of the raise: it is 1.50 for two or more such payments, 1.25 for exactly one, and 1.00 for none. The multiplier is applied to the tier's liability step premium itself, before the full-year liability step charge is rounded. Where the liability step premium carries more than one multiplier, the multipliers are first multiplied together and then applied once to the tier's liability step premium; none of them acts on the result of another.

**What is counted.** Every claim payment issued on this CondoGuard policy whose coverage part is medical payments to others or personal liability, dated fewer than 60 whole months before the day of the raise. Payments of the two coverage parts are counted together, and each payment counts, so two payments on one claim count as two. Payments on other coverage parts are not counted.

| Medical payments and personal liability claim payments in the window | Liability loss multiplier |
|---|---|
| two or more | 1.50 |
| exactly one | 1.25 |
| none | 1.00, no loss load |

## Cases (hypothetical claim histories)

- One medical payments payment issued 20 months ago and one personal liability payment issued 59 whole months ago: two payments in the window, 1.50.
- One personal liability payment issued 60 whole months before the day of the raise, and nothing since: it is not fewer than 60 whole months before, so the count is none, 1.00.
- One unit property payment and one medical payments payment, both last year: only the medical payments payment counts, exactly one, 1.25.

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

A tier liability step premium of 12.00 USD with exactly one counted payment, and no other multiplier on the step premium: 12.00 multiplied by 1.25 is 15.00 USD for the full-year liability step charge of one step.
